<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>*/*</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>cf9d01d3e73003009d6247e603f6a990</enforce_acl><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Upload File</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    // Use dataStream with GlideTextReader to handle text/plain content type
    // request.body.dataString throws errors for text/plain; charset=UTF-8
    var inputStream = request.body.dataStream;
    var reader = new GlideTextReader(inputStream);
    var body = '';
    var line;
    while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
        body += line + '\n';
    }
    body = body.trim();

    if (!body || body === '') {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Request body is empty. Expected pipe-delimited file content.'
        });
        return;
    }

    var lines = body.split('\n');
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        response.setStatus(400);
        response.setBody({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'File must contain a header row and at least one data row.'
        });
        return;
    }

    // Column mapping from header positions to table field names
    var fieldMap = [
        'email',                    // 0  - Email
        'last_name',                // 1  - Last_Name
        'first_name',              // 2  - First_Name
        'employee_sub_group_code', // 3  - Employee_Sub_Group_Code
        'employee_sub_group',      // 4  - Employee_Sub_Group(FT/PT/Temp)
        'status',                  // 5  - Status
        'business_phone',          // 6  - Business_Phone
        'business_extension',      // 7  - Business_Extension
        'cellphone',               // 8  - Cellphone
        'pager',                   // 9  - Pager
        'position_number',         // 10 - Position_Number
        'ee_id',                   // 11 - EE_Id
        'user_id',                 // 12 - User_Id
        'language',                // 13 - Language
        'cost_centre_number',      // 14 - Cost_Centre_Number
        'middle_name',             // 15 - Middle_Name
        'region',                  // 16 - Region
        'position_title',          // 17 - Position_Title
        'job_number',              // 18 - Job_Number
        'job_title',               // 19 - Job_Title
        'organization_number',     // 20 - Orginization_Number
        'organization_title',      // 21 - Organization_Title
        'personnel_area_number',   // 22 - Personnel_Area_Number
        'personnel_area',          // 23 - Personnel_Area
        'personnel_subarea_number', // 24 - Personnel_Subarea_Number
        'personnel_subarea',       // 25 - Personnel_Subarea
        'manager_ee_id',           // 26 - Manager_EE_ID
        'city',                    // 27 - City
        'postal_code',             // 28 - Postal_Code
        'street',                  // 29 - Street
        'province',                // 30 - Province
        'country'                  // 31 - Country
    ];

    var recordsInserted = 0;
    var errors = [];

    // Skip header row (index 0), process data rows
    for (var i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
        var line = lines[i].trim();
        if (line === '') {
            continue; // Skip empty lines
        }

        var values = line.split('|');
        if (values.length < fieldMap.length) {
            errors.push('Row ' + i + ': Expected ' + fieldMap.length + ' columns but found ' + values.length);
            continue;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_snc_file_ingest_employee');
        gr.initialize();

        for (var j = 0; j < fieldMap.length; j++) {
            var fieldName = fieldMap[j];
            var fieldValue = values[j] ? values[j].trim() : '';
            gr.setValue(fieldName, fieldValue);
        }

        var sysId = gr.insert();
        if (sysId) {
            recordsInserted++;
        } else {
            errors.push('Row ' + i + ': Failed to insert record');
        }
    }

    gs.info('File Ingest API: Processed file with ' + recordsInserted + ' records inserted');

    response.setStatus(201);
    response.setBody({
        status: 'success',
        records_inserted: recordsInserted,
        errors: errors,
        total_data_rows: lines.length - 1
    });
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_snc_file_ingest/file_ingest/upload</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/upload</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Accepts pipe-delimited employee data file content and creates records</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-27 17:55:04</sys_created_on><sys_id>badf190d353e4b008ea30e3b0b4ae6a8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Upload File</sys_name><sys_package display_value="File ingest" source="x_snc_file_ingest">5b000c2e5302c3d45df75ab0a0490eed</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="File ingest">5b000c2e5302c3d45df75ab0a0490eed</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_badf190d353e4b008ea30e3b0b4ae6a8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-27 17:55:04</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="File Ingest API">510518f4affd4bb4858d6b90713b732e</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
